messages:
Maya Chen: Quick async check-in — what I did / blockers / today
Maya Chen: Did: followed up with AcmeFin on renewal, gathered logs for their webhook failures. Blocker: customer sees intermittent 5xxs on webhook retries which is impacting their ingestion. Today: need eng triage + PR review so we can have a hotfix before renewal call next Tue.
Arun Patel: Thanks Maya. Can you paste an example request_id and the error snippet? I'll take initial look.
Maya Chen: request_id: rf-20260315-0a9c2f, sample error:
```
2026-03-15T14:02:11Z ERROR webhook-delivery id=rf-20260315-0a9c2f status=502 msg="upstream connection reset" retries=3
```
Maya Chen: Also seeing spike around 13:58-14:05 UTC, ~120 req/min for that customer. Staging can't reproduce.
Zoe Rivera: @Samir can you triage when you have a sec? This customer is high-touch and renewal call is scheduled Tue. If we can't promise a mitigation we risk churn.
Samir Gupta: On it. Initial glance: 502 + reset on retries could be transient network or our retry guard hitting an unexpected condition. Can you confirm if they're hitting our dedicated routing (dedicated pool) or hosted?
Maya Chen: They're on Dedicated capacity (tenant: acme-fin, pool: ded-us-east-2-2).
Samir Gupta: OK. That narrows it. Can you also share last 3 request_ids if available?
Maya Chen: rf-20260315-0a9c2f, rf-20260315-0a9c83, rf-20260315-0a9d01 — I pasted the logs into the incident doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4321 (private link)
Samir Gupta: Thanks. Quick plan: I'll add additional logging around the retry guard and a defensive check for upstream reset. I have a branch: fixes/webhook-retry-guard. Will open PR and request Arun for review. If it's safe, we can canary to ded-us-east-2-2 today.
Arun Patel: Ping me when PR is up. If it touches routing code, add a unit test for the retry logic and an integration smoke that simulates upstream reset. I can review mid-day.
Samir Gupta: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/9876 — small change + extra log. Test added.
Arun Patel: Looking now. Quick note: if staging can't reproduce, can we create a minimal replay against a staging endpoint that simulates the spike? That helped last time.
Samir Gupta: Good call — I'll push a replay script to the PR. Also plan B: if canary shows regressions, we'll enable fallback to a compatible model variant for this tenant to keep their app online while we debug.
Maya Chen: Appreciate that. ETA check — can we aim to have a canary by EOD PST? Renewal call prep is tomorrow; I need to update legal/comms with progress.
Samir Gupta: Yes, aiming EOD PST. If review is clean, canary in 3h. I'll post status here and tag @Arun when it's live.
Arun Patel: Reviewed, left one minor comment on test. If Samir addresses, I can approve quickly. :thumbsup:
Samir Gupta: Addressed, pushed fix. Requesting deploy to canary now.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: platform fixes/webhook-retry-guard -> canary ded-us-east-2-2 (started 2026-03-15T18:22:00Z)
Samir Gupta: Canary looks green on basic smoke. Initial metrics show error rate for acme-fin down from 6% -> 0.8% in the last 10m.
Maya Chen: Incredible — I'll update the renewal thread and tell AcmeFin we'll monitor during their next heavy job tomorrow. Thanks Samir + Arun.
Zoe Rivera: Great work team. Maya — please add a brief note to the renewal playbook with the mitigation and the PR link so CSMs can reference.
Maya Chen: Will do. I'll also follow up after the customer run tomorrow morning and post the outcome here.
Arun Patel: Nice. If anything odd crops up, ping eng-oncall and @Samir directly.
Maya Chen: Thanks everyone.
